text:
Quick update from PIBA Tel Aviv.

FYI:

We went today to renew our A5 and noticed some changes compared to previous years.

We always submit all the docs online 3 months before the appointment like they ask but we also print everything and take with us and all the years they always checked the printed docs and it seemed like they didn't care much about online submission. 

This year they checked ONLY docs that were submitted online and didn't even look at the printed documents that we brought with us. They also send home couples who didn't submit online prior the appointment.
